newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK BUILDER SEES 10-13 YR, $100 MLN EUROBOND.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK BUILDER SEES 10-13 YR, $100 MLN EUROBOND.

text.p: Slovak hydro-construction company Vodohospodarska Vystavba a.s. (VVB) said on Wednesday it planned to issue a $100 million tranche of Eurobonds within one month.
VVB Financial Director Marian Hvizdos told Reuters that the issue should have a maturity of 10 to 13 years. "We want long money, and we would prefer a maturity of 13 years," he said.
"We want to draw the funds in either U.S. dollars or German marks, but the latter option is more likely due to favourable interest rates on mark-denominated instruments," he added.
